MISSION VIEJO MINUTES
  Special City Council Meeting

  December 13, 2022

A Special Meeting of the City Council, the Community Development Financing Authority, the
Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency, the Housing Authority, and the
Library Board of Trustees of the City of Mission Viejo, California, was called to order by Council
Member Kelley at 4:30 p.m., on December 13, 2022, at 200 Civic Center, Mission Viejo,
California.

A complete copy of the agenda for the meeting containing all items as shown herein was posted
by 5:00 p.m. on December 8, 2022, on the outdoor bulletin board at City Hall. Copies were also
posted at Montanoso Recreation and Fitness Center, 25800 Montanoso Drive, and Norman P.
Murray Community and Senior Center, 24932 Veterans Way.

*All Board and Agency memberships are reflected in the title "Council Member."

Present:  Council Member Goodell
  Council Member Kelley

Absent:  None

Staff Present: Dennis Wilberg, City Manager
  William P. Curley III, City Attorney
  Keith Rattay, Assistant City Manager/Director of Public Services
  Cheryl Dyas, Director of Administrative Services
  Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

INVOCATION: Council Member Kelley

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Goodell

PUBLIC COMMENTS

Gary Stewart, M.V.: Complimented the Council and asked the City Council to look ahead to
prevent legal actions in the future. He questioned the methodology in selecting the interim Council
Member.

Walt Lawson, M.V.: Reminded and outlined to the Council and residents the reasons this special
meeting is necessary. He criticized Wendy Bucknum for attending city events in November and
December acting as if she was still a Council Member. Questioned the lack of disclosure on the

City Council Special Meeting Minutes  1  December 13, 2022
 agenda for the purpose of this meeting. Lastly, he stated residents can obtain more information on
the Mission Viejo Guardian.

Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: Spoke in solidarity with the Chinese people who are standing in opposition
to censorship. Questioned if the City Attorney manipulated the legal and political process for a
desired outcome. Expressed that the residents have been steamrolled. She criticized the City
Attorney for unethically discriminating against her. Stated the public record does not reflect the
reality of what happened to our city government and that the press releases were biased.

Larry Gilbert, M.V.: Opposed the selection of former Council Member Sherri Butterfield as
interim third member to the City Council. He outlined his reasons and suggest that Planning
Commissioner Robert Breton, or former Councilman Frank Ury would be a better choice.

Robert Breton, M.V.: Stated that the voters have spoken and that this is the time and proper place
to validate the voters and certify the election. Criticized the previous speaker and stated that former
Council Member Sherri Butterfield can carry out this ministerial perfunctory act. Voiced concern
that this Council is supposed to be non-partisan but looks like it is becoming partisan.

OPEN SESSION

1.  Appoint a third council member at a special meeting of the City Council and certify the
  2022 election results pursuant to adopting a resolution; Thereafter and immediately
  following at a regular meeting of the City Council swear in the 2022 (2023-2026) City
  Council and adopt a resolution ratifying all City Council actions relating to the
  implementation of the November 8, 2022, election results

  City Attorney Bill Curley Presented the Staff Report.

  Cathy Schlicht, M.V.: Stated that she holds no personal animosity toward Sherri Butterfield,
  but is concerned with the lack of public process. She outlined her concerns with this process.
  Lastly, she stated that Planning Commissioner Bob Breton should be disqualified from
  holding any future position in the City for trying to justify the unlawful behavior of this city
  government.

  Aaron Hand, M.V.: Wanted the public to be aware that the City filed a notice of appeal that
  only asked the appeal court for a writ of supersedeas and stay, which when it was dissolved
  resulted in the removal of the majority of the City Council. He stated that as to the Appeal
  on the Merits, the City has not appealed the Lower Courts ruling, and to say there is a lack
  of clarity, that would likely be because the City has not asked the Court of Appeal to weigh
  in on that fact or that issue of law.

  Motion made by Council Member Goodell, seconded by Council Member Kelley to appoint
  former Mayor and Councilwoman Sherri Butterfield.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Goodell and Kelley
  NOES:  None

City Council Special Meeting Minutes  2  December 13, 2022
   ABSENT:  None

  City Clerk Kimberly Schmitt issued the Oath of Office to Sherri Butterfield.

2.  Official Results of the November 8, 2022 General Municipal Election

  City Clerk Kimberly Schmitt presented the staff report.

  Motion made by Council Member Goodell, seconded by Council Member Butterfield to
  adopt Resolution 22-43 Reciting the Fact of the General Municipal Election Held on
  November 8, 2022, Declaring the Result and Such Other Matters as Provided by Law.

  On roll call, said motion carried by the following vote:

  AYES:  Butterfield, Goodell and Kelley
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

ADJOURNMENT

At the hour of 4:38 p.m., with no further business to come before the City Council at this special
meeting, Council Member Kelley adjourned the meeting

______________________________________________
Kimberly Schmitt, City Clerk

Approved at the meeting of January 10, 2023
